events.event: PDI-P executive Deddy Sitorus replies to the Gibran volunteer group Relawan Militan Gibran 08 Nusantara, saying PDI-P has moved on from 2024 and only discusses Jokowi's family as a case study on betrayal, after PDI-P called the VP diploma row a burden on the government.
events.key_numbers: Published 25 Oct 2026 08:50 WIB · volunteer chair Andi Azwan statement 24 Oct · 2 years of the Prabowo-Gibran government
events.why_it_matters: The Gibran diploma row is now a open PDI-P versus Jokowi-camp fight.
events.spreading_evidence: Listed among detik's latest politics headlines 25 Oct

events.event: BPK member (Anggota VI) Fathan Subchi, a former two-term PKB DPR member, has died, according to an announcement by PKB DPP.
events.key_numbers: Announced Sun 25 Oct 2026 · DPR member 2014-2024 · cause and age not stated
events.why_it_matters: A sitting state audit board member dies, leaving a seat at BPK that must be filled.
events.spreading_evidence: Listed among detik's latest headlines 25 Oct

events.event: Former TNI Commander Adm. (Ret.) Widodo Adi Sutjipto is buried with a military ceremony at Kalibata heroes' cemetery, attended by SBY, Defense Minister Sjafrie and TNI Commander Agus Subiyanto.
events.key_numbers: Burial 25 Oct 2026, 13:30 WIB · TNI Commander 1999-2002 · Menko Polhukam 2004-2009
events.why_it_matters: Marks the passing of a figure from Indonesia's post-Reformasi security leadership.

events.event: DPR Commission III deputy chair Ahmad Sahroni (NasDem) backs Luhut's proposal that state loss should not count as corruption and urges a revision of the Tipikor Law; KPK chair Setyo Budiyanto on 21 Oct said the state-loss element must stay.
events.key_numbers: Luhut met Prabowo 20 Oct 2026 · Sahroni 22 Oct · KPK response 21 Oct · UNCAC ratified via UU 7/2006 · KPK says four UNCAC offences still need provisions
events.why_it_matters: Changing what counts as corruption could limit which cases KPK and prosecutors can pursue.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets, Luhut-KPK exchange widely covered

events.event: The Constitutional Court (MK) is scheduled to hold a further hearing on the judicial review of the Elucidation of Article 603 KUHP (state-loss element); no outcome reported yet.
events.key_numbers: Hearing 26 Oct 2026 · Perkara 206/PUU-XXIV/2026 · no new reporting found as of 25 Oct
events.why_it_matters: The court case could decide who may calculate state loss in corruption cases.

events.event: KPK is scheduled to re-summon suspect DE in the BBPJN North Sumatra road-tender bribery case on 26 Oct; no new reporting found as of 25 Oct.
events.why_it_matters: Shows how far the road-tender graft case is widening.

events.event: Polda Metro Jaya is scheduled to hold a clarification summons of director Dandhy Dwi Laksono over the film 'Pesta Babi' on 27 Oct; his legal team says he cannot attend.
events.why_it_matters: A test of how police treat complaints about a documentary film.

events.event: East Jakarta District Court is scheduled to hear three prosecution witnesses in Roy Suryo's trial over Jokowi's diploma on 28 Oct, after judges rejected the defence objection on 19 Oct.
events.why_it_matters: The trial moves into evidence, possibly including the diploma itself.
